caseName: Cape Ann Granite Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: CAPE ANN GRANITE CO., INC. v. United States

opinions.text:
Government contract; extensions of time; unforeseeable causes.

Decided October 4, 1943; petition dismissed. Plaintiff’s motion for new trial overruled November 1, 1943. Opinion 100 C. CIs. 53.

Plaintiff’s petition for writ of certiorari denied by the Supreme Court March 27, 1944.
